provenance.notes: Datasheet: Semiware (Nanjing Shiheng) MF52A103F3950, product datasheet Rev. A2.0 (5 pages), bead-type NTC. Electrical characteristics table p.1: R25 10 kΩ ±1% at 25 °C, B25/50 3950 K ±1%, dissipation coefficient at least 2 mW/°C in still air, time constant at most 7 s, operating range -20 to 120 °C. Resistance-temperature table (Exhibit 1, p.3-4): -20 °C 97.8396 kΩ, 0 °C 32.7547 kΩ, 25 °C 10.0000 kΩ, 50 °C 3.5882 kΩ, 85 °C 1.0580 kΩ, 100 °C 0.6676 kΩ, 125 °C 0.3326 kΩ; B computed from the 25 and 50 °C rows is about 3950 K, so the table agrees with B25/50. A single B is only accurate near 25-50 °C (the 0 °C row implies about 3865 K), so the table points are kept for interpolation. Outline drawing p.1: body D 1.8-2.2 mm (max 2.2), body length L1 4 mm, total length L at most 32 mm, lead ø0.36 (printed '0.36±2mm', an obvious typo for a tolerance), lead spacing F 2.0 mm. The drawing shows a black epoxy drop, consistent with the kit photo. The sheet gives no thickness, so the body is assumed round for bodyMm [D, D, L1]. Kit: 'Thermistor x1' on the component list image; SunFounder 2.2.2 and its Components page say NTC, 10 kΩ at 25 °C and B = 3950, which equal this part's R25 and B25/50. SunFounder names no manufacturer or model, so this is the matching documented part. Spans: minSpan 1 (native 2.0 mm lead spacing bends to 2.54 mm). The sheet states only the maximum overall length (32 mm), not a minimum lead length, so maxSpan 6 is deliberately conservative (floor((2.0 + 2 x (15 - 8)) / 2.54) for an assumed 15 mm of lead, with the 8 mm bend/insertion allowance also a modelling assumption). This value is not verified by the datasheet.
